_about: Tests that fail off Windows for a cause nobody has fixed yet. CI (core.yml, unix-full.yml) leaves them out of the gate through tools/ci-known-gaps.py, runs them apart so their failure output is in the log, and lists them with these reasons in the job summary (tools/ci-test-report.py). Fixing one means deleting its line. A test is listed by a fragment of its name (ctest -R, '|' joins them). docs/building.md, "Platforms and their test status".
